behavior: Exact registered49 validator body is required before adding four closed original-reference shapes: fulfillment mode save, job book, before-work cancellation and schedule change. This proposal does not yet add the separate initialization reference shape.

Existing owner/recent-MFA/recovery retirement authority, unique operation key, immutable audit, original_recorded observation and independent financial capability requirements are reused unchanged. No new grant, table or generic payload is added.

For all four kinds a previously absent request can be reviewed and retired; its later actual original command returns an operation conflict without changing retained domain/operation/audit counts. Repeated retirement returns the same decision.
For all four kinds a recorded command remains original_recorded, no retirement replaces it, its original counts remain unchanged and the original command still returns its retained receipt.

Malformed versions/actions, hidden drafts, missing identifiers and attempted installation over a different validator body fail. New cases reuse one genuine retained synthetic agreement without raising recovery capacity.
limitations: The9 new original-review cases use restricted SQL session fixtures. The12 genuine password/TOTP cases cover the existing booking adapter, not the new original-reference transport.

Typed original-reference parser/client/private adapter/pending stores, initialization recovery handling and owner review UI still need connection before adoption. Original_recorded alone must never clear a pending reference; typed original receipt validation remains required.
Concurrent retirement-versus-original interleavings for these new kinds remain to be exercised before integrated release. Existing command concurrency tests remain in this61-case suite.
No registered50 adoption, booking screens, new full public CI/browser/device proof or preview activation. Full V1 scope remains unfinished.
